title: How to Interpret a Used-Car Paint-Thickness Report
search_intent: Decide whether a remote paint report supports procurement or needs reinspection
buyer_task: Separate measurement credibility, coating variation and unsupported accident-free conclusions
reference_market: Non-jurisdictional procurement method; Germany service example labelled

facts.claim: F/NF instruments depend on metallic substrate; plastic/composite requires a suitable different method such as validated ultrasonic equipment
Ordinary magnetic/eddy-current reading is total distance to base metal, not separate clearcoat thickness
No universal correct paint thickness or accident-free pass/fail cutoff
Calibration, verification and adjustment are distinct; certificate alone does not verify a current session
Geometry, surface condition, substrate and probe operation can change measurements
TÜV NORD Germany describes component paint readings as part of a broader vehicle assessment
Factory repaint can occur; variation is a reason to investigate, not proof of collision cause

editorial_methods: Request VIN-linked panel map, raw readings, photographs and excluded areas
Compare like substrate/geometry; repeat questionable readings
Use continue/clarify/hold purchase decisions without asserting an accident diagnosis
FACTS_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: F/NF instruments depend on metallic substrate; plastic/composite requires a suitable different method such as validated ultrasonic equipment

FACTS_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: Thickness proves factory paint, no accident, structural safety or legal eligibility
Unverified remaining clearcoat or repair cost
BLOCKED_FACTS: Vehicle-specific OEM paint specifications and individual accident/structural diagnosis not supplied; no such conclusions may be asserted
CONFLICT_LIST: Older Elcometer USA FAQ broadly says non-destructive plastic measurement is unavailable; excluded as overbroad against current DeFelsko ultrasonic guidance
TIME_SENSITIVE_FACTS: An individual vehicle report only describes the vehicle and session recorded; later repairs or transport damage need separate evidence

startup_gate.prewriting_error_check: No historical error triggered; no regulation/threshold/first-hand claims; official source scope separated from editorial recommendations
